_source.title: 缩放到坐标
_source.remarks.text.0: 在原理图、符号画布坐标单位跨度为 0.01inch，在 PCB、封装画布坐标单位跨度为 mil
_source.example.text.0: 1. 打开一个原理图页，确定缩放的画布
_source.params.x: 中心坐标 X，如若不传入则不改变当前 X 坐标
_source.params.y: 中心坐标 Y，如若不传入则不改变当前 Y 坐标
_source.params.scaleRatio: 缩放比，如若不传入则不改变当前缩放比，单位跨度为 `1/100`，如若传入 `200`，则表示缩放比为 `200%`
_source.params.tabId: 标签页 ID，如若未传入，则为最后输入焦点的画布
_source.returns: 缩放到的区域数据，`false` 表示画布不支持该缩放操作或 `tabId` 不存在

title: Zoom to coordinates
remarks.text.0: In the schematic and symbol canvases, the coordinate unit span is 0.01inch; in the PCB and footprint canvases, it is mil
params.x: Center X coordinate. If not passed in, the current X coordinate will not be changed
params.y: Center Y coordinate. If not passed in, the current Y coordinate will not be changed
params.scaleRatio: Zoom ratio. If not passed in, the current zoom ratio will not be changed. The unit span is `1/100`. If `200` is passed in, it means a zoom ratio of `200%`
params.tabId: Tab ID. If not passed in, the canvas with the last input focus will be used
returns: Region data after zooming. `false` indicates that the canvas does not support the zoom operation or the `tabId` does not exist
